_doc: Inventory/skill icons for `hdart icons`: FLUX.2-klein + pixel-art LoRA at 512 px, BiRefNet background removal, then reduced to `size` px with `colors` colours and a 1 px outline. Ids match content definitions (items.json, spells).

defaults.suffix: , dark fantasy dungeon crawler, single object centered, plain white background, 32-bit pixel art

item.iron_sword.prompt: an iron sword with a leather wrapped grip, diagonal

item.potion_small.prompt: a small round glass potion bottle with glowing red liquid and a cork

item.lockpicks.prompt: a set of thin metal lockpicks on a small ring

item.torch.prompt: a wooden torch with a bright orange flame

item.key_bone.prompt: an old key carved from pale bone

spell.firebolt.prompt: a fireball spell icon, swirling flame orb

spell.frost_lance.prompt: an icicle spear spell icon, pale blue ice shard

spell.mend.prompt: a healing spell icon, green leaf with glowing sparkles

spell.holy_ward.prompt: a golden holy shield spell icon with radiant glow

spell.soul_drain.prompt: a purple ghostly skull spell icon with wisps

spell.arc_bolt.prompt: a violet lightning bolt spell icon
